definitions.explanation: The quality or state of being indifferent or uninterested. The noun form of the na-adjective {無関心|むかんしん}, used when referring to indifference as a thing or concept itself.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{無関心|むかんしん}さ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{驚|おどろ}いた→驚く：01255_odoroku⟧。
examples.english: I was surprised by his indifference.

examples.japanese: ⟦{政治|せいじ}→政治：01629_seiji⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{無関心|むかんしん}さ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧になっている。
examples.english: Apathy toward politics has become a problem.

examples.japanese: ⟦{若者|わかもの}→若者：03037_wakamono⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{社会|しゃかい}{問題|もんだい}→社会問題：25686_shakaimondai⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{無関心|むかんしん}さ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{指摘|してき}→指摘：05630_shiteki⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The indifference of young people toward social issues has been pointed out.

examples.japanese: ⟦{環境|かんきょう}{問題|もんだい}→環境問題：10136_kankyoumondai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{対|たい}する→対する：02126_taisuru⟧{無関心|むかんしん}さ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{将来|しょうらい}→将来：01438_shourai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}を{及|およ}ぼす→影響を及ぼす：16547_eikyouwooyobosu⟧。
examples.english: Indifference to environmental problems will have a major impact on the future.

notes:
Formed by adding the suffix さ to the na-adjective ⟦{無関心|むかんしん}→無関心：13424_mukanshin⟧ (indifferent; uninterested), converting it into a noun that refers to the quality itself. This pattern (na-adjective + さ) is productive: ⟦{親切|しんせつ}→親切：01144_shinsetsu⟧さ (kindness), ⟦{真剣|しんけん}→真剣：01565_shinken⟧さ (seriousness), etc.

Often used in discussions of social or political apathy, especially in media commentary.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{政治|せいじ}→政治：01629_seiji⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{無関心|むかんしん}さ: political apathy
- ⟦{社会|しゃかい}→社会：01427_shakai⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{無関心|むかんしん}さ: social indifference
- ⟦{他人|たにん}→他人：01459_tanin⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{無関心|むかんしん}さ: indifference toward others

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{無関心|むかんしん}→無関心：13424_mukanshin⟧: indifferent — the base na-adjective form
- ⟦{無頓着|むとんちゃく}→無頓着：10911_mutonchaku⟧: unconcerned; carefree — implies not caring about details or appearances, often about personal matters
- ⟦{冷淡|れいたん}→冷淡：16166_reitan⟧: cold; indifferent — emphasizes emotional coldness toward a person, more personal than {無関心|むかんしん}さ
